marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 金强 著 | Jin Qiang zhu
中国大陆媒体对伊斯兰国家报道研究 （2001-2015） | Zhongguo dalu meiti dui yisilan guojia baodao yanjiu (2001-2015)

The objective of this book is to explore the Chinese media reports and its commentary about 57 member states of the Islamic cooperation organization, since September 11th, 2011 till the end of 2015, and analyze it quantitatively and qualitatively. The chapter structure were based on 5W model. With "One belt. one road" initiative and "community of human destiny" concept, this book aims to promote the development of the media communication of the developing countries, in order to establish media cooperation and consensus between China and BRI countries for better media and cultural ties.
